series_and_cup#sc-cup-bracket-structure.detail: Rewrote the cup_finals_pair_probability x cup_group_tiebreak_state interaction: halves are conferences, so a tiebreak cannot change half; it only changes seeding within the conference (group winner vs wild card, hence QF/SF hosting); East x West pairs always possible, same-conference pairs zero; test no longer references excluded pairs. nba.venue rationale now says only the Cup final (Hinkle) is neutral and QF/SF are hosted by the higher seed. Mirrored in reviews/NBA_b.json and input_patches/NBA_zfix.json.
